articles.summary: Daktronics (NASDAQ: DAKT), a recognized industry leader in digital display and control system technology, has named Amar G Subash vice president of international sales, effective October 21, 2026.
articles.title: Daktronics Names Amar G Subash as Vice President of International Sales

articles.summary: Daktronics (NASDAQ-DAKT) of Brookings, South Dakota, a recognized industry leader in digital display and control system technology, announced the launch of the new Galaxy® G7 electronic message center series, the next generation of the company’s Galaxy outdoor LED display platform.
articles.title: Daktronics Launches Galaxy G7, Redefining the Future of Outdoor Digital Signage

articles.summary: CURE Insurance Arena has partnered with Daktronics (NASDAQ: DAKT), a recognized industry leader in digital display and control system technology, to install a new five-display centerhung system and three entrance displays in Trenton, New Jersey.
articles.title: CURE Insurance Arena Enhances Live Event Experience With New Daktronics Displays

articles.summary: Daktronics (NASDAQ: DAKT), a recognized industry leader in digital display and control system technology, today hosted an inauguration ceremony to mark the opening of its new manufacturing facility in Saltillo, Mexico.
articles.title: Daktronics Opens Mexico Manufacturing Facility
